prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
The supplied image is the EDIT TARGET: the current burning/deflagration Pioneer card. Make ONE focused addition requested by the user: add a clearly readable expanding SHOCKWAVE RING around the burning unit.

Draw one coherent circular pressure wave originating from the central burning Pioneer. In this low three-quarter camera, render the circle as a correctly foreshortened ellipse in a plane approximately parallel to the battlefield ground, with its tilt matching the scene perspective. The ring expands beyond the unit's main body and leg footprint, roughly 1.5 times its overall footprint radius. Its near arc sweeps through the lower foreground in front of the lower legs; the far arc passes BEHIND the mech and flames with proper occlusion, and the lateral arcs remain readable on both sides. It must read as one encircling wave, not unrelated curved streaks.
Use a thin, crisp pale-ivory hot leading edge (#FEE4D9), a restrained warm orange fringe (#EE9D58), and a transparent heat/compressed-air band with a little dust swept outward close to the ground. Keep the wave's interior transparent so it never covers the robot, fire or scenery with an opaque disk. The pressure ring is secondary to the intense continuing fire and sudden flare-up.
Keep exactly ONE readable ring. Consolidate any small pre-existing disconnected pressure-arc fragments into this same ring if necessary. No multiple concentric rings, energy shield, spherical bubble, magic rune, targeting UI or circular graphic stamped flat on the image.

Strict preservation: keep the current burning effect, attached tongues of flame, incandescent armor seams, scorch marks, burning foreground fragments, smoke, robot structure, pose, camera, composition, colors, two background enemies, grass, ruins and sky. Do not revert to a clean robot with a central white explosion. Do not redesign or move the machines. Match the existing clean outlined anime cel shading and retain the square framing.
Output one finished opaque square illustration with the shockwave addition, no text, watermark, card frame, diagram, arrows or UI.
